entries.title: Job 8:1
segments: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

entries.title: Job 8:2
segments: How long wilt thou speak these things? And [how long] shall the words of thy mouth be [like] a mighty wind?

entries.title: Job 8:3
segments: Doth God pervert justice? Or doth the Almighty pervert righteousness?

entries.title: Job 8:4
segments: If thy children have sinned against him, And he hath delivered them into the hand of their transgression;

entries.title: Job 8:5
segments: If thou wouldest seek diligently unto God, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;

entries.title: Job 8:6
segments: If thou wert pure and upright: Surely now he would awake for thee, And make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

entries.title: Job 8:7
segments: And though thy beginning was small, Yet thy latter end would greatly increase.

entries.title: Job 8:8
segments: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, And apply thyself to that which their fathers have searched out:

entries.title: Job 8:9
segments: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days upon earth are a shadow);

entries.title: Job 8:10
segments: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, And utter words out of their heart?

entries.title: Job 8:11
segments: Can the rush grow up without mire? Can the flag grow without water?

entries.title: Job 8:12
segments: Whilst it is yet in its greenness, [and] not cut down, It withereth before any [other] herb.

entries.title: Job 8:13
segments: So are the paths of all that forget God; And the hope of the godless man shall perish:

entries.title: Job 8:14
segments: Whose confidence shall break in sunder, And whose trust is a spider's web.

entries.title: Job 8:15
segments: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: He shall hold fast thereby, but it shall not endure.

entries.title: Job 8:16
segments: He is green before the sun, And his shoots go forth over his garden.

entries.title: Job 8:17
segments: His roots are wrapped about the [stone] -heap, He beholdeth the place of stones.

entries.title: Job 8:18
segments: If he be destroyed from his place, Then it shall deny him, [saying], I have not seen thee.

entries.title: Job 8:19
segments: Behold, this is the joy of his way; And out of the earth shall others spring.

entries.title: Job 8:20
segments: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, Neither will he uphold the evil-doers.

entries.title: Job 8:21
segments: He will yet fill thy mouth with laughter, And thy lips with shouting.

entries.title: Job 8:22
segments: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; And the tent of the wicked shall be no more.
